title: Server integration tests for all HTTP endpoints and WG registration
description: Write integration tests: all HTTP endpoints (session CRUD, stream, approve, models, skills, pipeline, run, devices), SSE event correctness, auth (valid/invalid token, HMAC), rate limiting, WG registration flow (register peer, verify config, test tunnel connectivity). Target >80% coverage.
acceptance_criteria: All HTTP endpoints have integration tests
SSE stream test verifies correct event sequence (token, assistant, tool_call, tool_result, usage, done)
Auth tests: valid token, invalid token, missing token, HMAC verification
Rate limiting test: 429 after limit exceeded
WG registration test: register, verify config, tunnel connectivity
